title: Cost Centers — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A cost centre that salary costs are booked to. Employees are placed in one on their organisation assignment. A workflow step can limit its approvers to the requester's cost centre, and some customer-specific payroll journal reports group costs by it.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: CostCenterGroup
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Cost Center Group master data.
fields.html:
What it is. A group the cost centre belongs to.

Why it matters. Not read at present.
